description: This file defines an exported asynchronous function 'apiFetch' that wraps the native fetch API to facilitate HTTP requests to a backend service, handling base URL configuration, headers, and credentials. It is intended for use in a React project to interact with backend endpoints.

methods.name: apiFetch(path, options = {})
methods.description: An asynchronous function that constructs the full URL based on environment variables and performs a fetch request with specified options, handling default headers and JSON content type.
